description: Use this when the user asks what a number means in the quiniela or which number a dream corresponds to: '¿qué significa el 48?', 'el 23 en la quiniela', 'soñé con un perro'. Returns the meaning from the traditional quiniela dream table (la quiniela de los sueños) for a number from 00 to 99, plus the latest times it came out a la cabeza. Cultural tradition, not a prediction.

number.description: A number from 00 to 99 (longer numbers use their last two digits).

name: get_number_info
title: Significado de un número
